title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Fontana changes the meaning of a mirror sign through an explicitly written virtue/science register
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Fontana Secretum supplies two complete short symbol lists: four virtues and ten sciences. Mirror denotes providentia in the virtue list and perspectiva in the science list. This is an explicit representation-level switch with one shared visible carrier, not a global object-name decoder or an invented source pointer. Preserve both complete lists and every modifier; do not assign a Voynich word or infer a manuscript namespace from convenient folio boundaries.

historical_source.work: Giovanni Fontana, Secretum de thesauro experimentorum ymaginationis hominum, BnF NAL635, ff85v–88r
historical_source.available_primary_text_layer: Latin passages reproduced in Valentina Cacopardo, Memory and Imagination in the Ars Memorativa in Fifteenth-Century Italy, Warburg Institute PhD2021, printed pp88–89, notes208/210; following Battisti/Saccaro1984. Native manuscript not collated by this producer.
historical_source.register_virtues_complete: SIMILITER IN VIRTUTIBUS SICUD DE SANCTIS FATIAS ET ERIT HOC MODO: Tenens librum pro iusticia. Tenens columpnam pro fortitudine. Tenens speculum pro providencia. Tenens ancoram pro spe.
historical_source.register_sciences_complete: Idem et in scientiis signum haberi potest, ut sunt signa hec: SIGNA Tabula a.b.c.d. etc., est signum gramatice. Epistola retorice. Pulcer liber poesie. Duo serpentes obvii loice. Compasus geometrie. Tabula numeri arismetrice. Instrumenta musice. Sfera astrologie. Specula perspective. Urinale medicine.
historical_source.normalization_limits: These are reproduced historical Latin readings, not a diplomatic transcription performed here. speculum/specula and providencia/perspective are not silently treated as identical strings. Book vs beautiful book and holder vs object are retained distinct graphic/construction features. Both complete lists have to be explained; no selection of only urine glass or mirror.

design.mechanism: Represented subject is selected by an explicit semantic register plus the depicted sign. The visible object is a carrier of a concept and need not be the literal subject of the accompanying account. A whole entry must distinguish the carrier, the represented subject and the statement about representation.

finite_candidates.name: GLOBAL_LITERAL_OBJECT
finite_candidates.law: Every mirror sign denotes the physical object MIRROR, without any representation-level switch.

finite_candidates.name: SINGLE_GLOBAL_SYMBOL_VALUE
finite_candidates.law: A mirror sign denotes one fixed symbolic subject in every register.

finite_candidates.name: WRITTEN_REGISTER_SCOPED_SYMBOL
finite_candidates.law: The explicit virtue scope selects PROVIDENTIA for the mirror carrier; the explicit science scope selects PERSPECTIVA. Scope begins at its written class introduction and lasts through its complete listed entries.

design.unequal_consequence: The same carrier category supports two different named source subjects in two explicitly written lists. GLOBAL_LITERAL_OBJECT cannot reproduce the source pro/signum relations as literal naming; SINGLE_GLOBAL_SYMBOL_VALUE cannot retain both PROVIDENTIA and PERSPECTIVA. The scoped candidate retains both, without declaring every object occurrence a free homonym. This is a source-level consequence; it does not prove a Voynich representation operator.
design.full_construction_obligation: Retain the written relation between sign/carrier and subject, the four complete virtue entries and ten complete science entries, including their noun modifiers and different constructions. A Voynich whole-reading descendant would need to supply one repeated scope/representation construction with all old occurrences and unknowns preserved, rather than label any convenient page as a different namespace.
remaining_equivalent_rivals: An explicitly stated context-dependent symbolic polysemy can be observationally equivalent to the scoped codebook.

Carrier construction differs: holding a mirror versus mirrors as science signs. A context-sensitive carrier-composition account can therefore distinguish entries without a separately encoded namespace. Keep this rival, not an after-result excuse.
A literal account ABOUT a symbolic convention can mention mirrors while explaining another meaning. Merely counting physical-object nouns against abstract subjects will not decide it.
design.why_this_is_not_source_pointer: No target form means a source address and no historical book is proposed as the Voynich exemplar. The finite law concerns a represented concept versus its visible carrier under expressly written domain introductions; it does not recover a missing passage from a page number.
design.relation_to_memory_machines: In the same work the Speculum instrument stores ordered letters on independently rotated rings; that machine description is separate from the mirror symbol lists. The repeated lexical family speculum does not license one universal mechanism or denotation across device descriptions and symbolic registers.
design.smallest_next_step: Root first collates these two complete lists against the direct source or critical edition already being inspected. Only if an already admitted complete native account independently contains competing representation scopes should one draft the entire paired reading and specify which written continuation must change. No image hunt, decoder or general namespace classifier is proposed.
design.current_native_capacity: No target owner pair, scope word, mirror label or translated root selected. This RAW is not score-ready, has no independent native confirmation and is not a recommendation to implement a control.
design.word_selection_contract: No Voynich word meaning is assigned. Any descendant must retrieve exact profiles and claim-bearing priors for every proposed scope/carrier/subject form, including frequency, section dispersion, repetition, grammatical placement and old counterexamples. A short frequent word is not presumed AND, SIGN or SCOPE.
